verdict.rationale: AMD's official product page documents AV1 encode/decode support on the RX 9070 XT, directly addressing the media-engine acceleration claim. However, there is no mention of HEVC encode/decode support, no mention of creator-app (e.g., Adobe, DaVinci Resolve) acceleration, and no evidence of ISV/professional certification (e.g., AMD Pro driver certifications) for this card. Missing for 10: HEVC encoder/decoder specs, named creator-app acceleration features, and ISV/professional certification documentation.
